exact_prompt_lines: Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: canonical career-world project concept for project/contextforge@v1

Input images: Image 1 is the sole pre-frozen deterministic geometry constraint guide. Use it as footprint, axis, primary-mass, and connection authority, not as an edit target. Generate one new candidate. Do not use any v0, r1, peer, prior generated, conversation, or other raster image, and do not use any other tracer art.

GUIDE AUTHORITY - HIGHEST PRIORITY: Preserve the complete primary geometry shown by Image 1. The two hall legs occupy different world-perpendicular true-isometric ground axes; never place both legs on one projected direction or reconnect the concave notch into a straight bar.

PRIMARY GEOMETRY INVARIANT - HIGHEST PRIORITY: Show one fully visible unmistakable concave L-shaped fabrication-hall footprint. Leave the complete rendered plinth-top returns R_X-E-R_Y and both full incident return edges visible. Place the same-size tall archive tower at the outer tip of the +X hall leg, seated and connected to the hall and at least 48 painted screen pixels clear of both complete returns; do not place it at the elbow or on the camera-far return edge. Put one sawtooth bank on each leg: the +X-leg bank repeats along +X with ridges parallel to Y, while the +Y-leg bank repeats along +Y with ridges parallel to X. Preserve one elevated visibly diagonal non-axis bridge from the tower to one compact cylindrical compression house entirely inside the open missing quadrant but outside the L footprint; every painted bridge and cylinder face or edge must also remain at least 48 screen pixels clear of both complete returns.

Primary request: An L-shaped heavy fabrication hall carries sawtooth roof vaults on both perpendicular legs, the same-size tall offset archive tower at the outer +X-leg tip, and one visibly diagonal non-axis overhead transfer bridge that lands on a compact cylindrical compression house inside the open missing quadrant but outside the L footprint.
Scene/backdrop: isolated asset on a near-black navy technical drafting field with a faint true-isometric grid and no surrounding scene.
Style/medium: restrained technical-cartography line art, matte low-value faces, thin parallel strokes, minimal bloom, traceable hard edges, no perspective convergence.

Composition/framing: exactly one large, complete, unoccluded canonical hero view of this one asset, centered with generous margin. Show the complete L footprint, concavity, both incident returns, both roof banks, tower base, bridge landings, cylinder base, and every identity-defining connection needed for deterministic SVG tracing. Do not render a second view, alternate angle, LOD grid, inset, silhouette panel, comparison panel, palette strip, swatch, legend, caption, annotation, UI, border title, or decorative sheet furniture.

Projection: orthographic true-isometric; camera azimuth 225 degrees from north, look direction 45 degrees, elevation 35.264 degrees, roll 0; +Y projects upper-left; no authored rotation. World-perpendicular ground axes appear as the two canonical isometric directions with a 120-degree included angle, not a 90-degree screen corner.

Guide rendering note: faint grid, axis witnesses, and the late solid plinth-return topology trace in Image 1 are construction evidence only. Preserve the L/return geometry they prove, but do not turn those guide marks into rails, seams, walls, signs, labels, a second panel, or additional architecture.
Lighting/mood: fixed graphic face values, quiet and legible, no cinematic lighting and no cast shadow.

Color palette: Independent family: accent.emissive #B997FF, structure.base #30263C, line.primary #B49AD0, with the global near-black navy drafting field. Emissive detail may cover at most 3 percent of visible face area.
Palette presentation: apply palette values directly to geometry only. Do not render a palette strip, swatches, samples, legend, labels, or employer colors.
Materials/textures: matte technical-cartography faces only; top, lit side, and shadow side use deterministic palette values.
Text (verbatim): none.

Whole-image text rule: no word, letter, number, caption, label, legend, pseudo-text, logo, wordmark, watermark, UI, or marked sign or glyph plane anywhere in the PNG. Keep every sign or glyph plane completely blank and unmarked.

Identity constraints: Use the approved context-compression, workflow, data-contract, and TypeScript links as architecture-led identity. Forge language is abstract; no literal flames or measured compression. Preserve the complete connected hall, tower, bridge, and cylinder as a physically readable primary form. Geometry must be reconstructable as deterministic SVG without guessing hidden edges.

Preservation rule: Preserve all source identity, nonfailed primary forms, projection, authored orientation, one-hero composition, technical-cartography style, palette ownership, materials, evidence boundary, avoid list, and easter-egg rule. The deterministic guide implements only the explicitly authorized ContextForge footprint-axis, complete-return visibility, and tower-placement corrections; it does not authorize any other art-direction change.

Avoid: generated text, labels, initials, numbers, pseudo-text, logos, wordmarks, mascots, or watermarks; perspective convergence, camera rotation, cast shadows, PBR, photorealism, glass, chrome, cyberpunk neon, or fantasy styling; graph or dashboard layouts, logo plinths, unsupported factual architecture, private details, metrics, or real-campus implication; melted joins, impossible stairs or windows, disconnected masses, inconsistent axes, hidden geometry, silhouette-changing LOD drift, a straight or collinear hall, a covered elbow concavity, a covered full return, an axis-aligned bridge, or sawtooth banks that repeat on the same axis; anvil or flame icons; token counters; chat UI; compression ratios; multiple panels; alternate views; LOD captions; palette strips, swatches, or legends.
Easter egg rule: render no optional LOD-2 attachment or easter egg in this one-hero correction candidate.
Output intent: one safely traceable canonical master reference for D-010; not runtime art and not factual evidence.
